::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Cadence's India operation is its largest outside the US. Noida and Bengaluru centres develop core EDA tools including Virtuoso, Innovus, and Xcelium.
:::

## What does this firm design?

EDA tools (custom/analog design, digital implementation, verification, emulation), Tensilica processor IP, and system analysis tools for PCB/package design.
